title: 城市化与健康
text:
城市化进程对人类生理及心理健康究竟产生了何种深远影响？这一课题涉及社会学、流行病学以及环境科学等多个交叉领域。快速的城镇化导致人口高度密集，从而改变了居民的生活方式。久坐不动成为现代职场人士的普遍状态，直接增加了代谢性疾病的患病率。与此同时，工业排放与交通拥堵引发的大气污染严重威胁呼吸系统。细颗粒物能够穿透肺部屏障进入血液循环，诱发心血管功能紊乱。
除了物理环境，心理层面的异化同样不容忽视。高强度的竞争压力与社交关系的碎片化，导致焦虑症及抑郁倾向在都市人群中激增。这种现象被定义为城市压力综合征，其核心在于个体对环境掌控感的缺失。绿地空间的匮乏进一步削弱了自然疗法对精神压力的缓解作用。研究表明，接触植被能有效降低皮质醇水平。
然而，城市化也带来了医疗资源的高度集聚。先进的诊疗设备与顶尖专家使危重症的救治率大幅提升。公共卫生体系的完善确保了疫苗接种及传染病防控的效率。这种矛盾性要求政策制定者在追求经济增长的同时，必须兼顾生态宜居性。通过构建海绵城市与增加公园覆盖率，可以有效改善微气候。
未来的规划应聚焦于健康城市概念，将预防医学融入空间设计。通过优化交通布局减少通勤时间，有助于提升整体生活质量。跨学科的协作将为解决上述挑战提供理论支撑。最终目标是实现经济繁荣与身心健康的协同演进。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what directly increases the prevalence of metabolic disease among modern office workers?
options: Sedentary behavior becoming the norm
An increase in green space
A decrease in air pollution
A reduction in working hours

questions.prompt: How does fine particulate matter affect the body, according to the text?
options: It penetrates the lung barrier into the bloodstream and can trigger cardiovascular dysfunction
It is completely filtered out by the lungs and never enters the bloodstream
It only affects the skin, not internal organs
It strengthens the respiratory system over time

questions.prompt: What is 'urban stress syndrome' defined by, according to the text?
options: An individual's lack of a sense of control over their environment
A physical disease caused exclusively by air pollution
A condition that only affects rural populations
A syndrome with no relation to psychological factors

questions.prompt: What effect does contact with vegetation have, according to the research mentioned in the text?
options: It can effectively lower cortisol levels
It has no measurable effect on stress hormones
It increases anxiety in urban populations
It only benefits physical, not psychological, health

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is one benefit that urbanization brings, despite its challenges?
options: A high concentration of medical resources that raises the survival rate for critical illness
Complete elimination of all urban health risks
A total absence of air pollution in cities
A guaranteed reduction in anxiety and depression rates

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
